title.value: A Large-Scale, Open-Domain, Mixed-Interface Dialogue-Based ITS for STEM
title.justification: The title is accurately extracted from the top of the paper where it is clearly defined.
title.quote: A Large-Scale, Open-Domain, Mixed-Interface Dialogue-Based ITS for STEM

analysis.description: The paper presents Korbit, an innovative intelligent tutoring system (ITS) designed to provide interactive and personalized learning experiences in STEM subjects using machine learning, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning. It emphasizes automation, standardization, and the ability to scale content creation for thousands of subjects, significantly improving student learning outcomes and motivation compared to traditional methods.

type.justification: The paper includes multiple studies and experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of the Korbit ITS, providing empirical evidence of its impact on learning outcomes.
type.quote: We have conducted multiple studies to evaluate the Korbit ITS. Some of these studies have evaluated the entire system while others have focused on particular aspects or modules of the system.

name.justification: The paper focuses on the development and evaluation of Korbit, an intelligent tutoring system designed to enhance STEM education.
name.quote: We present Korbit, a large-scale, open-domain, mixed-interface, dialogue-based intelligent tutoring system (ITS).

name.justification: The Korbit system uses NLP to interact with students and evaluate their solutions.
name.quote: Korbit is a large-scale, open-domain, mixed-interface, dialogue-based ITS, which uses machine learning, natural language processing (NLP) and reinforcement learning to provide interactive, personalized learning online.

name.justification: Reinforcement learning is utilized in the Korbit system to optimize student interactions and improve learning outcomes over time.
name.quote: Furthermore, the transitions between the states of the finite-state machine is decided by a reinforcement learning model, which itself is agnostic to the underlying implementation of each state and also continues to improve as more and more data becomes available.

name.justification: Machine learning models are integral to the functionality of Korbit ITS, enabling it to evaluate and respond to student inputs.
name.quote: Korbit is a large-scale, open-domain, mixed-interface, dialogue-based ITS, which uses machine learning, natural language processing (NLP) and reinforcement learning (RL) to provide interactive, personalized learning online.

name.quote: The Korbit ITS is closely related to the line of work on dialogue-based ITS, such as the pioneering AutoTutor and the newer IBM Watson Tutor.
